name: ITM Power Plc
summary: ITM Power Plc designs and manufactures proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolysers in the United Kingdom, Germany, rest of Europe, the United States, Australia, and internationally. It offers TRIDENT, a PEM electrolyzer stack technology; NEPTUNE, a plug and play electrolyzer for small to mid-size projects; POSEIDON, a 20 MW electrolysis process module for large-scale projects; and ALPHA 50, a 50 MW full-scope green hydrogen plant. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Sheffield, the United Kingdom.
